release_notes:
New app: 902 Batch Validator.

Use this on a 902 batch and it tells you which parts are missing files or
have corrupted data.

It reads the part list off EB's Offload to ASA workbook (or the pricing
workbook if present), so you can run it the day the batch lands. Then it
opens every DXF and IGES to check there's actual geometry in the file, and
finally it reads the prints in the WPDD folder. The part number on the
prints has weird formatting the system struggles with, so it uses our
system from the Inspection Dimensions app to parse the data. A 90 page
book takes about two minutes.

- A part lands on the flagged list for one of four reasons: no DXF was
  sent, the DXF is empty or damaged, the IGES is corrupt or holds no part
  outline, or no print was sent.

Run this on either the batch folder or the folder with the part files in
it. Both work.

911 LST Organizer final report has been overhauled to match 922 LST
Organizer.

The pull report is now one color-coded PDF, the same as the 922 one,
instead of a text file. Missing parts and nests it could not find in red,
revision letter swaps in blue, then the pull list grouped by nest. The
popup at the end names the parts with no .lst file, and the last line in
the console opens the report when you click it.

911 Setup: Scribe verification sheet now fits the nest.

Previously both SACO templates' sheet contained room for 24 parts, which
was an oversight on my part. So on a bigger nest everything past the 24th
part never appeared. The table now expands to the correct length of the
nest. So a 26 part nest now actually prints 26 lines. Additional changes
include:

- Parts are now in the same order as the nest package summary, which is
  the order QA walks them in at final inspection. The inspection sheets
  follow the same order.

- On a plate run the MIL SPEC column now follows the stock. Carbon plate
  is N/A. Non-ferrous plate gets each part's own MIL spec, read off the
  labeling block at the bottom of that part's PART SKETCH page. A part
  with no spec printed is left blank and the console names it.

- The whole NEST tab is centered now, not just the top of it.

902 DXF Prep now reads that same Offload to ASA workbook, so it works on a
batch before the pricing workbook exists, and it recognises EB's longer
file names instead of moving them to the EXTRA folder.
